message.name: AccountHoldingInformationV10
message.definition: Scope|The AccountHoldingInformation message is sent by an executing party, for example, a (old) plan manager (transferor), to the instructing party, for example, a (new) plan manager (transferee), to provide information about financial instruments held on behalf of a client.|Usage|The AccountHoldingInformation message is used to provide information on the individual assets held in a client's account. The assets may be part of a tax efficient product, a pension of general investment product.

rules.name: SocialSecurityNumberGuideline
rules.text: The UK Insurance Number must be indicated without spaces.

rules.name: SpecificPreviousYearsGuideline
rules.text: SpecificPreviousYears must not contain the current year.

rules.name: TotalAmountYearToDateRule
rules.text: TotalAmountYearToDate must be equal to the sum of EquityComponent and CashComponent if present.

rules.name: BlockTransferRetirementAgeProtectionRule
rules.text: If BlockTransfer is "false" or "0" (No), then RetirementAgeProtection is not allowed.|If BlockTransfer is "true" or "1" (Yes), then RetirementAgeProtection may be present.

rules.name: RetirementAgeRule
rules.text: If RetirementAgeProtection is "false" or "0" (No), then RetirementAge is not allowed.|If RetirementAgeProtection is "true" or "1" (Yes), then RetirementAge may be present.

rules.name: BlockTransferTaxFreeCashProtectionRule
rules.text: If BlockTransfer is "false" or "0" (No), then TaxFreeCashProtection is not allowed.|If BlockTransfer is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashProtection may be present.

rules.name: TaxFreeCashAmountRule
rules.text: If TaxFreeCashProtection is "false" or "0" (No), then TaxFreeCashAmount is not allowed.|If TaxFreeCashProtection is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashAmount may be present.

rules.name: RingFencedDrawdownAssets1Rule
rules.text: If DrawdownStatus/Code/NONE (None) is present, then RingFencedDrawdownAssets is not allowed.

rules.name: PensionOrderTypeGuideline
rules.text: A pension policy, plan or scheme cannot have both an earmark and a sharing order.|If PensionOrder/Type/Code/SHAR is present, then PensionOrder/Type/Code/EARM is not allowed.|If PensionOrder/Type/Code/EARM is present, then PensionOrder/Type/Code/SHAR is not allowed.

rules.name: TaxFreeCashAndValueRule
rules.text: If TaxFreeCashProtection is "true" or "1" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashAmount and ValueOfPensionPolicyOrPlanOrScheme must be present.|If TaxFreeCashProtection is "false" or "0" (Yes), then TaxFreeCashAmount and ValueOfPensionPolicyOrPlanOrScheme may be present.

rules.name: TransferScopeTrancheIdentification1Rule
rules.text: If TransferScope/Code/SDDT (DrawdownTranche) is not present, then DrawdownTrancheIdentification is not allowed.|If TransferScope/Code/SDDT (DrawdownTranche) is present, then DrawdownTrancheIdentification may be present.

rules.name: RingFencedDrawdownAssets2Rule
rules.text: If DrawdownStatus/Code/PART (Partial) or FULL (Full) is present, then RingFencedDrawdownAssets must be present.

rules.name: IdentificationGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: IdentificationGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DiscountElementRule
rules.text: Amount Or Rate Or Basis must be present.

rules.name: AppliedAmountRule
rules.text: If InformativeIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then AppliedAmount must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: NonStandardSLAReferenceRule
rules.text: For each value of IndividualFee/Type, NonStandardSLAReference may only be present once.

rules.name: TransactionOverheadElementRule
rules.text: One of the elements (TotalOverheadApplied, TotalFees, TotalTaxes, CommercialAgreementReference, IndividualFee, IndividualTax) must be present.

rules.name: AdditonalDetailsGuideline
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, DeclarationlDetails, RegistrationDetails and PartyContactDetails must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: AdditonalDetailsGuideline
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, DeclarationlDetails, RegistrationDetails and PartyContactDetails must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: Party2PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party2 is present, then Party1 must be present.

rules.name: Party3PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party3 is present, then Party2 must be present.

rules.name: Party4PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party4 is present, then Party3 must be present.

rules.name: Party5PresenceRule
rules.text: If Party5 is present, then Party4 must be present.

rules.name: SettlementChainGuideline
rules.text: SMPG recommends that at least three settlement parties be instructed in equity or fixed income receive|free or against payment settlement instructions; the depository, the participant of the depository (Party1) and the client of Party1 (Party2).|The data format for the identification of Party1 depends on the market. If no country specific requirement is available, BIC is recommended.|For more details, see the relevant market practice document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: DepositoryGuideline
rules.text: In a delivery, the receiving depository is to be understood as the requested depository of the receiving counterparty. |In a receive, the delivering depository is to be understood as the requested depository of the delivering counterparty.|The field must be populated with the BIC of a national or international CSD. When no CSD exists in a particular market, the stock exchange BIC will be used.|Country code should be used for settlement taking place outside of an institution published in the PSET's BIC list. This includes physical deliveries and investment funds not settling at a CSD. |The format and content of the settlement party sequences will comply with the market practices published for the counterparty depository included in the message.|For more details, see the relevant market practice document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: BookTransferGuideline
rules.text: In the case of an own account internal transfer, the account of (delivering) Party2 at (delivering) Party1 must be provided.|For more details, see the relevant market practice document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: AssetQuantity1Guideline
rules.text: If Instrument/Security is present, then Quantity/Unit or Quantity/FaceAmount or Quantity/AmortisedValue must be present.

rules.name: AssetQuantity2Guideline
rules.text: If Instrument/CashAsset is present, then Quantity/CashAmount must be present.

rules.name: ExtensionRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of the Registration Authority and without strict usage rules published by the Registration Authority.

rules.name: NomineeAccountServicerRule
rules.text: NomineeAccount/Servicer must be present when and only when different from TransferorAccount/Servicer.

rules.name: Investor1Rule
rules.text: If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is not present, then SecondaryIndividualInvestor is not allowed.|If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is present, then SecondaryIndividualInvestor may be present.

rules.name: Investor2Rule
rules.text: If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is not present, then OtherIndividualInvestor is not allowed. |If PrimaryIndividualInvestor is present, then OtherIndividualInvestor may be present.

rules.name: Corporate2Rule
rules.text: If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is not present, then OtherCorporateInvestor is not allowed.|If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is present, then OtherCorporateInvestor may be present.

rules.name: Corporate1Rule
rules.text: If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is not present, then SecondaryCorporateInvestor is not allowed.|If PrimaryCorporateInvestor is present, then SecondaryCorporateInvestor may be present.
